name: British Virgin Islands
rule: Current plant-import guidance describes nursery plants and growing material rather than manufactured tea. The official index as at 1 January 2026 confirms the operative Plant Protection Ordinance Cap. 93 (1941), 1991 regulations and amendments through 2002. The Food Security and Sustainability Act 2022 is expressly not in force, so its broader food licensing cannot be applied.
personalMailApplicability: No personal postal processed-tea exception or explicit classification found.
authority: British Virgin Islands Department of Agriculture
remainingQuestion: Actual current Cap.93 definition and operative subsidiary schedules remain missing; the January 2026 official index identifies the legislation but is not its substantive rules. A general published definition/schedule would suffice; no individualized tea letter is inherently necessary.
